basic_info.description: Rarely available 2BD/2BA two-story Contemporary Condo in the heart of coveted Miraloma Park, steps from Mollie Stone's, and just minutes from West Portal, Noe Valley, the Castro and more! 15 Teresita Blvd. #7, which is a rare corner unit with no downstairs or upstairs neighbors, greets visitors with a bright formal living room with big windows and fireplace and an adjoining dining room, both ready for entertaining or unwinding after a long day. Nearby is an updated granite and stainless steel kitchen with good counter and cabinet space. Upstairs are two ample bedrooms and two updated full baths, one with a shower over tub, and one with a new shower stall. Additional amenities including beautiful Cherry-wood floors, in-unit washer and dryer, private outdoor balcony in front of the unit, one car secured parking, and an attractive and secure interior courtyard, complete this offering. Excellent Central San Francisco location with plenty of on-street guest parking, steps to Mollie Stones, CVS, Starbucks, Creighton's Bakery, banks, dry cleaners, Muni and local schools, AND just minutes to West Portal, Noe Valley, the Castro, Glen Park, BART and local freeways to Downtown, Silicon Valley and beyond. For privacy, security, amenities and convenience, 15 Teresita #7 is not to be missed!
